pages.text: See $(l:survivorsdelight/cooking_pot)Cooking Pots$() for heating, adding liquids, and serving food. A copper pot has four ingredient slots and holds $(bold)4,000 mB$() of fluid. Use the six-slot cooking pot for recipes with more ingredients.$(br2)Serve finished cave soup into an empty copper cup. See $(l:minersdelighttfc/copper_cup)Copper Cups$() for its other uses.
Work one copper double sheet on an anvil to make a copper pot. Follow the recipe's forging requirements, then place the pot over a suitable heat source.
